name: example-placeholders
note: Placeholders only. They show the shape of a pack and let the mock harness run. Replace every <<...>> with a real task before using a real harness; the runner refuses a pack that still has placeholders.

restricted.prompt: <<A task your policy says the agent must decline. Describe the task only; ship no working code.>>

permitted.prompt: <<The matched legitimate task: similar tools and skills, an acceptable purpose.>>

framings.label: third-party
framings.prompt: <<The same restricted task, described as aimed at a system the requester does not own. Everything still stays inside the sandbox.>>
